-- Find the top-selling product by quantity among customers who bought YouTube Men's Vintage Henley in July 2017
WITH customers_with_henley AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h, UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
),
customer_purchases AS (
  SELECT 
    c.fullVisitorId,
    p.v2ProductName,
    p.productQuantity
  FROM customers_with_henley c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` s
    ON c.fullVisitorId = s.fullVisitorId
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(s.hits) AS h
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE s._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
)
SELECT 
  v2ProductName,
  SUM(productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM customer_purchases
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH session_product AS (
  SELECT 
    t.fullVisitorId,
    t.visitId,
    t.totals.transactions,
    t.totals.pageviews,
    t.date,
    MAX(hp.productRevenue) as max_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*` AS t,
  UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS hp
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
  GROUP BY t.fullVisitorId, t.visitId, t.totals.transactions, t.totals.pageviews, t.date
),
session_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitId,
    transactions,
    pageviews,
    date,
    CASE 
      WHEN transactions >= 1 AND max_product_revenue IS NOT NULL THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN transactions IS NULL AND max_product_revenue IS NULL THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END as session_type
  FROM session_product
)
SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
  session_type,
  ROUND(AVG(pageviews), 2) as avg_pageviews
FROM session_classified
WHERE session_type IN ('purchase', 'non-purchase')
GROUP BY month, session_type
ORDER BY month, session_type

WITH inpatient_avg AS (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, AVG(average_total_payments) as avg_inpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
),
outpatient_avg AS (
  SELECT provider_id, provider_name, AVG(average_total_payments) as avg_outpatient_payment
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.outpatient_charges_2014`
  GROUP BY provider_id, provider_name
)
SELECT 
  i.provider_id,
  i.provider_name,
  ROUND(i.avg_inpatient_payment, 2) as avg_inpatient_payment,
  ROUND(o.avg_outpatient_payment, 2) as avg_outpatient_payment,
  ROUND(i.avg_inpatient_payment + o.avg_outpatient_payment, 2) as combined_avg_cost
FROM inpatient_avg i
JOIN outpatient_avg o ON i.provider_id = o.provider_id
ORDER BY combined_avg_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    nppes_provider_state AS state,
    SUM(total_claim_count) AS total_claim_count,
    SUM(total_drug_cost) AS total_drug_cost
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
WHERE drug_name = 'AMLODIPINE BESYLATE'
GROUP BY nppes_provider_state
ORDER BY total_claim_count DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH icd_to_snomed AS (
  SELECT concept_id_1 as icd_id, concept_id_2 as snomed_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship`
  WHERE concept_id_1 IN (1569798, 1569765, 1569777, 35208655)
    AND relationship_id = 'Maps to'
),
snomed_descendants AS (
  SELECT ancestor_concept_id as snomed_id, descendant_concept_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_ancestor`
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (141095, 138502, 140168, 133834)
),
condition_persons AS (
  SELECT dm.icd_id, COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) as person_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.condition_occurrence` co
  JOIN snomed_descendants sd ON co.condition_concept_id = sd.descendant_concept_id
  JOIN icd_to_snomed dm ON sd.snomed_id = dm.snomed_id
  GROUP BY dm.icd_id
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) as total_participants
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.person`
)
SELECT 
  c.concept_code as icd10_code,
  c.concept_name as condition_name,
  cp.person_count,
  t.total_participants,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(cp.person_count, t.total_participants) * 100 as percentage
FROM condition_persons cp
CROSS JOIN total t
JOIN icd_to_snomed dm ON cp.icd_id = dm.icd_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept` c ON dm.icd_id = c.concept_id
ORDER BY c.concept_code

WITH monthly_avgs AS (
  SELECT year, month, AVG(air_temperature) AS avg_air, AVG(wetbulb_temperature) AS avg_wb, AVG(dewpoint_temperature) AS avg_dp, AVG(sea_surface_temp) AS avg_sst
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2010` WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014 AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, AVG(air_temperature), AVG(wetbulb_temperature), AVG(dewpoint_temperature), AVG(sea_surface_temp)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2011` WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014 AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, AVG(air_temperature), AVG(wetbulb_temperature), AVG(dewpoint_temperature), AVG(sea_surface_temp)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2012` WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014 AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, AVG(air_temperature), AVG(wetbulb_temperature), AVG(dewpoint_temperature), AVG(sea_surface_temp)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2013` WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014 AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year, month
  UNION ALL
  SELECT year, month, AVG(air_temperature), AVG(wetbulb_temperature), AVG(dewpoint_temperature), AVG(sea_surface_temp)
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_icoads.icoads_core_2014` WHERE year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2014 AND air_temperature IS NOT NULL AND wetbulb_temperature IS NOT NULL AND dewpoint_temperature IS NOT NULL AND sea_surface_temp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year, month
),
with_diffs AS (
  SELECT year, month,
    ABS(avg_air - avg_wb) + ABS(avg_air - avg_dp) + ABS(avg_air - avg_sst) + 
    ABS(avg_wb - avg_dp) + ABS(avg_wb - avg_sst) + ABS(avg_dp - avg_sst) AS sum_abs_diffs
  FROM monthly_avgs
)
SELECT year, month, sum_abs_diffs
FROM with_diffs
ORDER BY sum_abs_diffs ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    temp AS temp_f,
    prcp AS prcp_in,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp_knots
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '725290'
    AND year = '2019'
    AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
    AND temp != 9999.9
    AND prcp != 99.99
    AND wdsp != '999.9'
),
with_conversions AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    ROUND((temp_f - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp_in * 2.54, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(wdsp_knots * 0.514444, 1) AS wdsp_ms
  FROM daily
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wdsp_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wdsp_ma8
  FROM with_conversions
),
with_lags AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    temp_c,
    prcp_cm,
    wdsp_ms,
    temp_ma8,
    prcp_ma8,
    wdsp_ma8,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_1,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_1,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_1,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_2,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_2,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_2,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_3,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_3,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_3,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_4,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_4,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_4,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_5,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_5,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_5,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_6,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_6,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_6,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_7,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_7,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_7,
    ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_ma_diff_8,
    ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_ma_diff_8,
    ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_ma_diff_8
  FROM with_ma
)
SELECT
  date,
  temp_c,
  prcp_cm,
  wdsp_ms,
  temp_ma8,
  prcp_ma8,
  wdsp_ma8,
  temp_ma_diff_1,
  prcp_ma_diff_1,
  wdsp_ma_diff_1,
  temp_ma_diff_2,
  prcp_ma_diff_2,
  wdsp_ma_diff_2,
  temp_ma_diff_3,
  prcp_ma_diff_3,
  wdsp_ma_diff_3,
  temp_ma_diff_4,
  prcp_ma_diff_4,
  wdsp_ma_diff_4,
  temp_ma_diff_5,
  prcp_ma_diff_5,
  wdsp_ma_diff_5,
  temp_ma_diff_6,
  prcp_ma_diff_6,
  wdsp_ma_diff_6,
  temp_ma_diff_7,
  prcp_ma_diff_7,
  wdsp_ma_diff_7,
  temp_ma_diff_8,
  prcp_ma_diff_8,
  wdsp_ma_diff_8
FROM with_lags
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date
LIMIT 15

-- Get max precipitation, min temp, max temp for last 15 days of each year 2013-2016
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) as year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10) ELSE NULL END) as max_precip_mm,
  MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10) ELSE NULL END) as min_temp_c,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(value, 10) ELSE NULL END) as max_temp_c
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '2013' AND '2016'
  AND id = 'USW00094846'
  AND date >= DATE(CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS STRING), '-12-17'))
  AND date <= DATE(CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS STRING), '-12-31'))
  AND qflag IS NULL
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
ORDER BY year

-- Final answer: change in number of living trees per fall color from 1995 to 2015
WITH living_1995 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(t.spc_latin) as species_upper,
    COUNT(*) as tree_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_1995` t
  WHERE t.status != 'Dead'
    AND t.spc_latin NOT IN ('PLANTING SITE', 'UNKNOWN LIVE TREES', 'UNKNOWN DEAD TREES', 'UNKNOWN STUMP', 'UNKNOWN SHAFT', 'STUMP', 'SHRUB', 'HEDGE', 'PALM SPECIES')
  GROUP BY UPPER(t.spc_latin)
),
alive_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(t.spc_latin) as species_upper,
    COUNT(*) as tree_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_census_2015` t
  WHERE t.status = 'Alive'
    AND t.spc_latin IS NOT NULL AND t.spc_latin != ''
  GROUP BY UPPER(t.spc_latin)
),
species_colors AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(species_scientific_name) as species_upper,
    fall_color
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species`
),
matched AS (
  SELECT 
    sc.species_upper,
    sc.fall_color,
    COALESCE(l195.tree_count, 0) as count_1995,
    COALESCE(a215.tree_count, 0) as count_2015,
    COALESCE(l195.tree_count, 0) - COALESCE(a215.tree_count, 0) as diff
  FROM species_colors sc
  JOIN living_1995 l195 ON sc.species_upper = l195.species_upper
  JOIN alive_2015 a215 ON sc.species_upper = a215.species_upper
)
SELECT 
  fall_color,
  SUM(diff) as total_change
FROM matched
GROUP BY fall_color
ORDER BY fall_color

WITH yellow_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    extra,
    mta_tax,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    airport_fee,
    total_amount,
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01 00:00:00'
    AND dropoff_datetime <= '2016-07-07 23:59:59'
    AND passenger_count > 5
    AND trip_distance >= 10
    AND COALESCE(tip_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(tolls_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(mta_tax, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(fare_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(total_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
),
green_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_location_id,
    dropoff_location_id,
    passenger_count,
    trip_distance,
    fare_amount,
    extra,
    mta_tax,
    tip_amount,
    tolls_amount,
    airport_fee,
    total_amount,
    pickup_datetime,
    dropoff_datetime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_green_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_datetime >= '2016-07-01 00:00:00'
    AND dropoff_datetime <= '2016-07-07 23:59:59'
    AND passenger_count > 5
    AND trip_distance >= 10
    AND COALESCE(tip_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(tolls_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(mta_tax, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(fare_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND COALESCE(total_amount, 0) >= 0
    AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
),
all_trips AS (
  SELECT * FROM yellow_trips
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM green_trips
)
SELECT 
  pz.zone_name AS pickup_zone,
  dz.zone_name AS dropoff_zone,
  TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) AS trip_duration_seconds,
  t.trip_distance / SAFE_DIVIDE(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(t.dropoff_datetime, t.pickup_datetime, SECOND) / 3600.0, 1) AS driving_speed_mph,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount * 100, t.total_amount) AS tip_rate_pct,
  t.total_amount
FROM all_trips t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` pz ON t.pickup_location_id = pz.zone_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` dz ON t.dropoff_location_id = dz.zone_id
ORDER BY t.total_amount DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT country, year_2019 FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country` WHERE country IN ('United States', 'France', 'China', 'Italy', 'Spain', 'Germany', 'Iran')

SELECT 
  cc.county_name as county_name,
  cc.state as state,
  c.median_age,
  c.total_pop,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cc._2020_08_27 * 100000.0, c.total_pop), 1) as cases_per_100k,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(d._2020_08_27 * 100000.0, c.total_pop), 1) as deaths_per_100k,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(d._2020_08_27 * 100.0, cc._2020_08_27), 2) as case_fatality_rate
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_usafacts.confirmed_cases` cc
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.covid19_usafacts.deaths` d
  ON cc.county_fips_code = d.county_fips_code
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2020_5yr` c
  ON LPAD(CAST(c.geo_id AS STRING), 5, '0') = cc.county_fips_code
WHERE c.total_pop > 50000
  AND cc._2020_08_27 > 0
ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(d._2020_08_27 * 100.0, cc._2020_08_27) DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
    a.geo_id
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr` a
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` b
    ON a.geo_id = b.geo_id
WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '06%'
ORDER BY (b.median_income - a.median_income) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH scoring_events AS (
  SELECT 
    game_clock,
    period,
    elapsed_time_sec,
    team_name,
    team_market,
    points_scored,
    event_description,
    event_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, event_id) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE game_id = '95cda731-b593-42cd-8573-621a3d1369dc'
    AND points_scored > 0
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    s.game_clock,
    s.period,
    s.elapsed_time_sec,
    s.team_name,
    s.team_market,
    s.points_scored,
    s.event_description,
    s.event_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s2.team_market = 'Kentucky' THEN s2.points_scored ELSE 0 END) AS wildcats_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s2.team_market = 'Notre Dame' THEN s2.points_scored ELSE 0 END) AS fighting_irish_score
  FROM scoring_events s
  JOIN scoring_events s2 ON s2.rn <= s.rn
  GROUP BY s.game_clock, s.period, s.elapsed_time_sec, s.team_name, s.team_market, s.points_scored, s.event_description, s.event_id, s.rn
)
SELECT 
  game_clock,
  CAST(period AS STRING) AS period,
  team_name,
  team_market,
  CAST(points_scored AS INT64) AS points_scored,
  event_description,
  CAST(wildcats_score AS INT64) AS wildcats_score,
  CAST(fighting_irish_score AS INT64) AS fighting_irish_score
FROM cumulative
ORDER BY elapsed_time_sec, event_id

WITH season_max AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    MAX(wins) as max_wins
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons`
  WHERE season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
    AND name IS NOT NULL 
    AND name != ''
  GROUP BY season
),
peak_teams AS (
  SELECT 
    s.market,
    s.name,
    s.season,
    s.wins
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_historical_teams_seasons` s
  JOIN season_max sm ON s.season = sm.season
  WHERE s.season BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000
    AND s.name IS NOT NULL 
    AND s.name != ''
    AND s.wins = sm.max_wins
)
SELECT market, COUNT(*) as peak_seasons
FROM peak_teams
GROUP BY market
ORDER BY peak_seasons DESC, market ASC
LIMIT 5

WITH google_hiring AS (
  SELECT
    'Google Overall Hiring' AS category,
    gender_us,
    ROUND(race_asian * 100, 1) AS asian_pct,
    ROUND(race_black * 100, 1) AS black_pct,
    ROUND(race_hispanic_latinx * 100, 1) AS hispanic_latinx_pct,
    ROUND(race_white * 100, 1) AS white_pct,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS tech_sector
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_intersectional_hiring`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
google_representation AS (
  SELECT
    'Google Overall Representation' AS category,
    gender_us,
    ROUND(race_asian * 100, 1) AS asian_pct,
    ROUND(race_black * 100, 1) AS black_pct,
    ROUND(race_hispanic_latinx * 100, 1) AS hispanic_latinx_pct,
    ROUND(race_white * 100, 1) AS white_pct,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS tech_sector
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
bls_tech AS (
  SELECT
    'BLS Technology Sectors' AS category,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS gender_us,
    ROUND(percent_asian * 100, 1) AS asian_pct,
    ROUND(percent_black_or_african_american * 100, 1) AS black_pct,
    ROUND(percent_hispanic_or_latino * 100, 1) AS hispanic_latinx_pct,
    ROUND(percent_white * 100, 1) AS white_pct,
    CASE 
      WHEN subsector = 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals' THEN 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals'
      WHEN industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services' THEN 'Computer systems design and related services'
    END AS tech_sector
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021

WITH patient_mutation AS (
  SELECT 
    p.bcr_patient_barcode,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_kras,
    MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_tp53
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup` p
  LEFT JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample` m
    ON p.bcr_patient_barcode = m.ParticipantBarcode 
    AND m.Study = 'PAAD'
  WHERE p.acronym = 'PAAD'
  GROUP BY p.bcr_patient_barcode
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as a,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as b,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as c,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as d
  FROM patient_mutation
)
SELECT 
  a, b, c, d,
  (a + b + c + d) as grand_total,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    POWER((a * (a + b + c + d)) - ((a + b) * (a + c)), 2) * (a + b + c + d),
    (a + b) * (c + d) * (a + c) * (b + d)
  ) as chi_squared
FROM contingency

WITH mitelman_gains AS (
  SELECT 
    Chromosome,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(TotalCases AS INT64)) AS FLOAT64) as frequency
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentNumData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401' AND Abnormality LIKE '+%'
  GROUP BY Chromosome
),
tcga_amplifications AS (
  SELECT 
    Chromosome,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(TotalCases AS INT64)) AS FLOAT64) as frequency
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401' AND Type = 'U' AND (Abnormality LIKE 'dup%' OR Abnormality LIKE 'add%')
  GROUP BY Chromosome
),
mitelman_losses AS (
  SELECT 
    Chromosome,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(TotalCases AS INT64)) AS FLOAT64) as frequency
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentNumData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401' AND Abnormality LIKE '-%'
  GROUP BY Chromosome
),
tcga_deletions AS (
  SELECT 
    Chromosome,
    CAST(SUM(CAST(TotalCases AS INT64)) AS FLOAT64) as frequency
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401' AND Type = 'U' AND Abnormality LIKE 'del%'
  GROUP BY Chromosome
),
gain_corr AS (
  SELECT 
    CORR(m.frequency, t.frequency) as r,
    COUNT(*) as n
  FROM mitelman_gains m
  LEFT JOIN tcga_amplifications t ON m.Chromosome = t.Chromosome
),
loss_corr AS (
  SELECT 
    CORR(m.frequency, t.frequency) as r,
    COUNT(*) as n
  FROM mitelman_losses m
  LEFT JOIN tcga_deletions t ON m.Chromosome = t.Chromosome
)
SELECT 
  'gain vs amplification' as aberration_type,
  r as pearson_correlation,
  n as n_records
FROM gain_corr
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'loss vs deletion' as aberration_type,
  r as pearson_correlation,
  n as n_records
FROM loss_corr

  AVG(CASE WHEN is_purchaser = 0 THEN pageviews END) as avg_pageviews_non_purchasers,
  AVG(CASE WHEN is_purchaser = 1 THEN pageviews END) - AVG(CASE WHEN is_purchaser = 0 THEN pageviews END) as avg_difference
FROM user_pageviews

WITH page_view_events AS (
  SELECT 
    ep_session.value.int_value as session_id,
    ep_page.value.string_value as page_title
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210102` e,
  UNNEST(e.event_params) as ep_session,
  UNNEST(e.event_params) as ep_page
  WHERE e.event_name = 'page_view'
    AND ep_session.key = 'ga_session_id'
    AND ep_page.key = 'page_title'
    AND ep_page.value.string_value IS NOT NULL
),
session_pages AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN page_title = 'Home' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_home,
    MAX(CASE WHEN page_title = 'Checkout Confirmation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_checkout
  FROM page_view_events
  GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_home = 1 AND has_checkout = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(has_home)) * 100 as conversion_rate
FROM session_pages

WITH event_params_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_timestamp,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN CAST(ep.value.int_value AS STRING) END) AS ga_session_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'session_engaged' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS session_engaged
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, event_timestamp
),
engaged_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    ga_session_id
  FROM event_params_agg
  WHERE session_engaged = '1'
    AND ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
),
session_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    COUNT(*) AS engaged_session_count
  FROM engaged_sessions
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_users,
  SUM(engaged_session_count) AS total_engaged_sessions,
  AVG(engaged_session_count) AS avg_engaged_sessions_per_user
FROM session_counts

WITH all_params AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'ga_session_id' THEN CAST(e.value.int_value AS STRING) END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) as ga_session_id,
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'source' THEN e.value.string_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) as source,
    (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'medium' THEN e.value.string_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) as medium,
    event_timestamp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e WHERE e.key = 'ga_session_id') > 0
    AND ((SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'source' THEN e.value.string_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) IS NOT NULL 
         OR (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN e.key = 'medium' THEN e.value.string_value END) FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS e) IS NOT NULL)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    source,
    medium,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ga_session_id ORDER BY event_timestamp) as rn
  FROM all_params
),
session_source AS (
  SELECT ga_session_id, source, medium
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
),
channel_classified AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN source IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex', 'in.search.yahoo.com', 'm.baidu.com', 'yandex.ru')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN source IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex', 'in.search.yahoo.com', 'm.baidu.com', 'yandex.ru')
           OR medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN (source IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'shop|shopping'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN (source IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart')
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'shop|shopping'))
           AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
           OR medium IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'dailymotion|disneyplus|netflix|youtube|vimeo|twitch')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'dailymotion|disneyplus|netflix|youtube|vimeo|twitch')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'video') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR medium = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN medium = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN medium = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'email|e-mail|e_mail|e mail')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'email|e-mail|e_mail|e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN medium = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'push')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'mobile')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, 'cross-network') THEN 'Cross-network'
